_instructions: Translate every value (not keys). Keep {P}, {FABRIC}, {SIZES} placeholders exactly. Keep printed garment lettering that appears in capitals or quotes-like phrases (MERRY XMAS!, TEAM SANTA, SANTA'S crew, LET IT SNOW, I'M JUST HERE for the COOKIES, Lights Out!, We are Family, Jolly Crew, Joyful Merry Blessed, Cookie Baking Crew, beary cozy) verbatim inside translated sentences, because they describe what is printed on the garment. Keep size labels S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL, 4XL and all numbers/percent values exactly. Keep 'Dress Like Mommy' untranslated. Translate print names naturally (they are product style names) so they are NOT identical to the English.
